violations.text: Raw animal foods (shelled eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (drinks) in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2026

Sanitizer (quaternary Ammonium) test strips were observed expired (expiration dates of 2018–2023). Expired test strips may not provide accurate sanitizer concentration readings and must be replaced. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2026

The door to the outside, located in the basement, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 12/08/2025
